description: This file defines the 'FiscalYear' document class and related functions for managing fiscal years, including validation, setting defaults, overlap checks, and auto-creation of fiscal years in an ERP system.

classes.name: FiscalYearIncorrectDate
classes.description: Custom validation error for incorrect fiscal year dates.

classes.name: FiscalYear
classes.description: Main class representing a fiscal year with methods for validation, setting defaults, and overlap checks.

methods.name: set_as_default
methods.description: Sets the current fiscal year as the default in global settings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the fiscal year's dates and overlap constraints.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Checks that the start and end dates are in correct order and duration.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions after saving, such as duplicate checks and cache clearing.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Prevents deletion if the fiscal year is set as default.
